drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 88-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.89, creatinine 1.01, hemoglobin 12.4, pao2 56, platelets 257, sodium 140, wbc 6.3; vitals dbp 74-78, heart_rate 74-78, map 90-94, o2_flow 0-5, resp_rate 27-31, sbp 122-127, spo2 87-93, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Oxygen via nasal cannula 5 L/min
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.97, hemoglobin 12.4, platelets 259, sodium 141, wbc 6.3; vitals dbp 73-77, heart_rate 74-78, map 90-93, o2_flow 5, resp_rate 20-26, sbp 121-125, spo2 93-95, temp 36.7-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 88-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
